subject.title: [Feature]: Expose sessionKey/runId to outbound message hook for deterministic verification

question: What bounded outbound hook evidence contract should OpenClaw expose for deterministic pre-send claim verification?
rationale: The missing behavior is real, but exposing transcript/tool-call/result evidence to plugins is a public API and sensitive-data boundary that needs maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Add redacted evidence to message_sending
options.body: Extend `message_sending` with optional run/session identity and a bounded, redacted evidence view that can support cancel/modify before channel delivery.

options.title: Make reply_payload_sending the evidence API
options.body: Keep `message_sending` narrow and make `reply_payload_sending` the documented pre-send verification surface, adding only the fields needed for deterministic claims.

options.title: Fold into broader outbound policy work
options.body: Defer this issue into the larger unbypassable outbound policy and trace-context design so the hook surface is solved once across all send paths.

recommendation.title: Add redacted evidence to message_sending
recommendation.body: Extend `message_sending` with optional run/session identity and a bounded, redacted evidence view that can support cancel/modify before channel delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses Plugin SDK, outbound delivery, and sensitive-data policy, and steipete is the clearest recent maintainer-side reviewer/merger signal for the closest outbound hook work.
